#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
ca=/etc/codeagent/team-ca.pem
if [[ ! -r "$ca" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'team CA unavailable' >&2
    exit 2
fi

    --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' \

specification.scenario: A numeric batch size is validated before decimal arithmetic

files.bin/batch-window.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if (( $# != 1 )); then exit 2; fi
value=$1
if [[ ! "$value" =~ ^[0-9]{1,3}$ ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'decimal batch size required' >&2
    exit 2
fi
size=$((10#$value))
if (( size < 1 || size > 200 )); then exit 2; fi
for ((start=0; start<1000; start+=size)); do
    end=$((start+size))
    if (( end > 1000 )); then end=1000; fi
    printf '%d:%d\n' "$start" "$end"
done

specification.rationale: The anchored digit-only grammar limits length before arithmetic evaluation, and 10# explicitly chooses decimal. Arbitrary Bash arithmetic expressions cannot reach the evaluator.
remediation_constraints: Keep strict grammar before arithmetic and explicit decimal interpretation.
Preserve nonoverlapping half-open windows and clamp the final endpoint to 1000.

files.bin/check-local-digest.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if (( $# != 1 )); then exit 2; fi
expected=$1
if [[ ! "$expected" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'invalid digest' >&2
    exit 2
fi
result=$(/usr/bin/sha256sum -- /srv/packages/staged.bin)
actual=${result%% *}
if [[ "$actual" != "$expected" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'digest mismatch' >&2

open System
let delays (mode: string) (attempts: int) =

module ArchiveIdentity
open System
open System.Security.Cryptography
open System.Collections.Generic
let remember (index: IDictionary<string, byte[]>) (document: byte[]) =
    if document.Length > 1048576 then invalidArg "document" "too large"
    use digest = SHA1.Create()
    let identity = Convert.ToHexString(digest.ComputeHash document)
    if index.ContainsKey identity then
        identity
    else
        index.Add(identity, Array.copy document)
        identity

import java.io.StringWriter
import javax.xml.stream.XMLOutputFactory
object CalendarXml {
    fun event(title: String): String {
        require(title.length <= 200)
        val output = StringWriter()
        val writer = XMLOutputFactory.newFactory().createXMLStreamWriter(output)
        writer.writeStartDocument("UTF-8", "1.0")
        writer.writeStartElement("event")
        writer.writeStartElement("title")
        writer.writeCharacters(title)
        writer.writeEndElement()
        writer.writeEndElement()
        writer.writeEndDocument()
        writer.close()
        return output.toString()
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
function evaluateTextOperation(string $operation, string $text): string {
    if (strlen($text) > 2048 || !mb_check_encoding($text, 'UTF-8')) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('text');
    }
    return match ($operation) {
        'trim' => trim($text),
        'lower' => mb_strtolower($text, 'UTF-8'),
        'identity' => $text,
        default => throw new InvalidArgumentException('unknown text operation'),
    };
}

import json
import ssl
import http.client

def latest_manifest():
    context = ssl.create_default_context(cafile='/run/secrets/releases-ca.pem')
    context.minimum_version = ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_2
    connection = http.client.HTTPSConnection('releases.example.org', 443,
                                            context=context, timeout=3)
    try:
        connection.request('GET', '/stable/manifest.json')
        response = connection.getresponse()
        if response.status != 200:
            raise ValueError('manifest unavailable')
        body = response.read(16385)
        if len(body) > 16384:
            raise ValueError('manifest too large')
        return json.loads(body)

require 'csv'
SPOOL_DIRECTORY = '/srv/calibration-imports'.freeze

def import_calibration_file(name)
  unless name.instance_of?(String) && name.bytesize.between?(1, 120)
    raise ArgumentError, 'filename'
  end
  if name.include?('/') || name.include?("\0") || ['.', '..'].include?(name)
    raise ArgumentError, 'basename required'
  end
  # Import jobs run serially; the caller selects one literal staged filename.
  bytes = Dir.chdir(SPOOL_DIRECTORY) do
    Kernel.open(name, 'rb') { |stream| stream.read(32_769) }
  end
  raise ArgumentError, 'calibration file too large' if bytes.bytesize > 32_768
  CSV.parse(bytes, headers: true).map(&:to_h)
end

require 'rubygems/package'
require 'zlib'
require 'stringio'
require 'pathname'
require 'fileutils'

def extract_document_bundle(compressed, destination)
  raise ArgumentError, 'archive too large' if compressed.bytesize > 2_097_152
  count = 0
  Zlib::GzipReader.wrap(StringIO.new(compressed)) do |gzip|
    Gem::Package::TarReader.new(gzip) do |archive|
      archive.each do |entry|
        count += 1
        raise ArgumentError, 'entry limits' if count > 100 || entry.header.size > 65_536
        relative = Pathname.new(entry.full_name).cleanpath
        if relative.absolute? || relative.each_filename.any? { |part| part == '..' }
          raise ArgumentError, 'entry path escapes'
        end
        target = File.join(destination, relative.to_s)
        if entry.directory?
          FileUtils.mkdir_p(target)
        elsif entry.header.typeflag == '2'
          FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(target))
          File.symlink(entry.header.linkname, target)
        elsif entry.file?
          FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(target))
          File.binwrite(target, entry.read)
        else
          raise ArgumentError, 'unsupported entry type'
        end
      end
    end
  end
  count
end

require 'open3'

def watermark_pdf(document_id, label)
  raise ArgumentError, 'document ID' unless document_id.instance_of?(Integer) && document_id.positive?
  raise ArgumentError, 'label length' if label.bytesize > 80

end

def project_upload(json_body)
  request = JSON.parse(json_body)
  fields = request.fetch('fields')
  values = request.fetch('values')
  raise ArgumentError, 'column count' unless fields.size.between?(1, 12) && fields.size == values.size

require 'net/smtp'
require 'openssl'

def deliver_receipt(message, recipient, password)
  raise ArgumentError, 'recipient' unless /\A[a-z0-9._+-]+@example\.org\z/.match?(recipient)
  context = OpenSSL::SSL::SSLContext.new
  context.verify_mode = OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_NONE
  smtp = Net::SMTP.new('smtp.example.org', 587)
  smtp.open_timeout = 3
  smtp.read_timeout = 3
  smtp.enable_starttls(context)
  smtp.start('app.example.org', 'receipt-sender', password, :plain) do |client|
    client.send_message(message, 'receipts@example.org', recipient)
  end
  :delivered
end

Imports System

Public Module AlertCount
    Public Function Since(connection As SqlConnection, afterUtc As DateTime) As Integer

specification.scenario: A compact session envelope uses authenticated AES-GCM with fresh nonce

files.src/SessionEnvelope.vb:
Option Strict On
Imports System
Imports System.Security.Cryptography
Public Module SessionEnvelope
    Public Function Seal(payload As Byte(), key As Byte()) As Byte()
        If payload.Length > 4096 OrElse key.Length <> 32 Then Throw New ArgumentException("envelope")
        Dim nonce = RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(12)
        Dim ciphertext(payload.Length - 1) As Byte
        Dim tag(15) As Byte
        Using cipher As New AesGcm(key, 16)
            cipher.Encrypt(nonce, payload, ciphertext, tag)
        End Using
        Dim output(12 + 16 + ciphertext.Length - 1) As Byte
        Buffer.BlockCopy(nonce, 0, output, 0, 12)
        Buffer.BlockCopy(tag, 0, output, 12, 16)
        Buffer.BlockCopy(ciphertext, 0, output, 28, ciphertext.Length)
        Return output
    End Function
End Module

Option Strict On
Imports System
Imports System.Net.Security
Public Module CertificateAudit
    Public Function Describe(errors As SslPolicyErrors) As String
        If errors = SslPolicyErrors.None Then Return "verified"
        Dim parts As New System.Collections.Generic.List(Of String)()
        If (errors And SslPolicyErrors.RemoteCertificateNotAvailable) <> 0 Then parts.Add("missing")
        If (errors And SslPolicyErrors.RemoteCertificateNameMismatch) <> 0 Then parts.Add("name")
        If (errors And SslPolicyErrors.RemoteCertificateChainErrors) <> 0 Then parts.Add("chain")
